children: Niki BioSolutions entered into an At the Market Offering Agreement to sell up to $1.396 million of common stock from time to time through H.C. Wainwright as sales agent, with Brookline Capital Markets acting as qualified independent underwriter due to a conflict. Sales will occur at prevailing market prices, and Wainwright will receive a 3.0% placement fee. The company and agents may suspend or terminate the program at any time. The arrangement provides flexible access to equity financing.
: At-the-market equity offering program for common stock
